summary: The latent-trap record landed correctly: the trigger Fact (revision 2) keeps its own wording, conditions and source list and now cites the latent-trap receipt together with the earlier ones, the parent interpretation carries the causal refinement with the right receipt id, and the recorded knowledge uses now point at both the trigger Fact and the repair Fact from the interpretations that rely on them. Earlier in the turn I caught and fixed a content mismatch before it could ship — my first version of the trigger Fact entry carried the repair Fact's wording under the trigger Fact's id, so the statement, conditions and sources were restored from the stored record and only the new evidence was added. With no other claim untested and the total budget nearly spent, I used the remaining room for the one thing that still adds value: one repeat of the latent-trap experiment from its retained inputs, so the contrast that pins the trigger — configuration kept with nothing staged, lost once the flag-on path had staged a commit index — is reproduced rather than resting on a single run.
